review.verdict: First on six of nine bosses
review.summary: The most damage on Venoxis, Mar'li, Thekal, Arlokk, Jin'do and Hakkar, second on Mandokir and Wushoolay, third on Jeklik. Average parse 89 against your usual 63. No deaths.

good.title: Damage
good.text: First on six bosses, top three on all nine.

review.summary: Parse 91 on Wushoolay, 87 on Mandokir, 84 on Jin'do. Fifth on Jin'do. Average 78.
78 dispels, the most by far: 30 Venom Spit, 12 Tranquilizing Poison, 8 Infected Bite, 5 Wyvern Sting. Second of the healers on Jeklik, Mar'li and Mandokir.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last of four on Wushoolay and Arlokk.

review.summary: First of the healers on Venoxis, Mar'li, Mandokir (38%), Wushoolay, Thekal, Arlokk and Hakkar, and dispelled the Hex on Jin'do. A Voodoo Spirit killed you on trash in the first minute.
Parse 87 on Wushoolay, 86 on Jeklik, 76 on Hakkar. A trash death to a Mad Servant.
9 Curses of Blood removed and two interrupts. Parse 90 on Arlokk. 12th to 14th on most bosses.

review.verdict: Fourth of four healers on most bosses
review.summary: Fourth of the four healers on seven bosses, 2% of the healing on Jeklik and 4% on Jin'do. Third on Wushoolay and Arlokk.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last of four on seven bosses.

review.summary: Tanked eight bosses, parse 96 on Wushoolay and 90 on Mar'li. Wushoolay killed you at 0:29 and Thekal at 0:51 (Paidwithbeer rezzed you). Mind-controlled four times on Hakkar. A trash death to a Mad Voidwalker.
Second on Venoxis and Thekal, fourth on Jin'do and Hakkar. Average 67 against your usual 48.

review.verdict: First on Jeklik and Mandokir, tanked Arlokk
review.summary: First on Jeklik and Mandokir, second on Mar'li and Jin'do, third on Wushoolay, Thekal and Hakkar, and tanked Arlokk to a 95. Average 85 against your usual 54. A trash death to a Berserker.

review.verdict: Rebirth on Macharius, first healer on Jeklik and Jin'do
review.summary: First of the healers on Jeklik (42%) and Jin'do, second on five more. Rebirth on Macharius on Thekal. 24 dispels.

review.verdict: Last on five bosses, killed by Zealot Zath
review.summary: Playing damage: last on Jeklik, Venoxis, Mar'li, Wushoolay and Jin'do. Zealot Zath's Sweeping Strikes killed you on Thekal at 0:42.
Sixth on Jin'do, eighth on five bosses. Average 46.
11th to 14th on every boss you were on, average 32, nothing logged on Thekal. A Zulian Crocolisk killed you on trash.
Sixth on Jeklik and Thekal, seventh on Arlokk, Jin'do and Hakkar. 14th on Mar'li (parse 7). A Drain Life kicked.

review.verdict: Tanked three bosses, died to Hakkar near the end
review.summary: Tanked Mandokir (parse 83), Thekal and Hakkar, third on Arlokk. Hakkar killed you at 1:41, two seconds before he died.
Fifth on Venoxis and Arlokk, sixth on Mar'li, Wushoolay and Hakkar. Jeklik (13th, parse 18) was low.

review.verdict: First on Wushoolay, second on Jeklik, Arlokk and Hakkar
review.summary: First on Wushoolay, second on Jeklik (parse 96), Arlokk and Hakkar (92). Three interrupts including a Great Heal, 8 Curses of Blood removed. Average 82.

review.verdict: Fourth on five bosses, killed by Wushoolay
review.summary: Fourth on Jeklik, Mar'li, Mandokir, Wushoolay and Arlokk. Wushoolay killed you at 0:30, a second after Macharius.

review.verdict: Near the bottom on every boss
review.summary: 11th to 14th on every boss, average parse 23. Last on Mandokir.
